text: The contraction-mapping proof in the ESN chapter establishes which condition as SUFFICIENT for the ESP under any bounded input?
choices: The spectral radius rho(W_rec) < 1, which is also necessary in the nonlinear case
The largest singular value (spectral norm) ||W_rec||_2 = sigma_max(W_rec) < 1
The trace of W_rec being less than 1
The leak rate alpha < 1, regardless of W_rec
explanation: The Banach/contraction argument bounds the map's Lipschitz constant by (1-alpha) + alpha*||W_rec||_2, which is < 1 exactly when the spectral norm ||W_rec||_2 = sigma_max(W_rec) < 1 (the leak rate cancels out, so option D is wrong). This singular-value condition is sufficient but conservative. Option A confuses it with the weaker spectral-radius rule and wrongly calls rho<1 necessary in the nonlinear case; the trace is unrelated to contractivity.
